exercises.prompt: Select the correct attached pronoun form for 'in his house' (with vowel harmony after kasrah).
exercises.explanation: بَيْتِ is genitive (-i) after فِي, so the 3ms suffix shifts from ـهُ to ـهِ: بَيْتِهِ.

feedback.rule: 3rd-person suffixes (-hu, -humā, -hum, -hunna) shift ḍammah to kasrah after kasrah or yāʾ.

exercises.prompt: True or False: A noun with an attached possessive pronoun (such as كِتَابُهُ) may also take the definite article أَلْ (الكِتَابُهُ).
exercises.explanation: False. The attached pronoun functions as a muḍāf ilayh, so the noun acts as muḍāf and never takes أَلْ or tanwīn.

feedback.rule: Noun + attached pronoun = iḍāfah (no أَلْ, no tanwīn).

exercises.prompt: What is the grammatical role of the suffix ـهِ in فِي بَيْتِهِ?
choices: Muḍāf ilayh (in the place of genitive / في محل جر)
exercises.answer: Muḍāf ilayh (in the place of genitive / في محل جر)
exercises.explanation: Any pronoun attached to a noun serves as its muḍāf ilayh (genitive possessor).

feedback.rule: Attached pronoun on a noun = muḍāf ilayh.
